spans.s: Myrobalan,Ⓒs.ⒹAmalakaH-kI-kaM, tizyaPalA, amftA, vayasTA; (‘beleric m(yrobalan)’) viBItakaH-kI-kaM, akzaH, tuzaH, karzaPalaH, BUtAvAsaH, kalidrumaH; ‘yellow m(yrobalan)’ avyaTA, aBayA, paTyA, kAyasTA, pUtanA, amftA, harItakI, hEmavatI, cetakI, SreyasI, SivA.
Myrrh,Ⓒs.ⒹbolaH, gaMDarasaH, rasagaMDaH, prARaH, piMqaH, goparasaH, gopaH, rasaH, gosaH.
